newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean stocks end soft as market digest earnings.
newsitem.headline: Chilean stocks end soft as market digest earnings.

text.p: Chilean blue chips ended softer on Thursday, as investors paused for breath amid a slew of company earnings released this week, traders saod.
The market is seen opening steady, with players waiting to see the outcome of talks between Spanish utility Endesa and the controllers of Enersis, traders said. A deal is believed to be imminent.
The 40-share index ended down 0.43 percent at 134.09 points. The general index shed 0.19 percent to 5,706.7 points on turnover of 12.1 billion pesos.
